environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. ALB performs TLS termination only. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy-level authorization. CloudWatch logs enabled for ALB access logs but no real-time alerting configured. The application handles all authorization internally.

config.network: ALB -> EC2:8080, SG allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
config.alb_rules: default action: forward to target group
config.iam: EC2 instance role with S3 read for config only
config.monitoring: CloudWatch ALB access logs, no alerting
